name: Bones
overview: Scripture reveals the significance of bones as both a symbol of identity and God's sovereign care in creation and covenant. From Adam's declaration that Eve was 'bone of my bones' (Genesis 2:23), highlighting the intimate connection within God's design, to Joseph's insistence that his bones be carried from Egypt as a testimony to God's faithfulness (Genesis 50:25; Exodus 13:19), bones represent continuity and hope. The Psalms express the deep anguish that affects even the bones (Psalms 32:3), while Job acknowledges God's intricate craftsmanship in forming his bones (Job 10:8) and the strength of creation's bones (Job 40:18). These passages collectively point to God's intimate involvement with our physical being and His sustaining power over life and death.
